exclusions: Every lead and candidate from all earlier immutable requests was excluded before ranking; this specifically removed Germanium and both R 417 remix leads surfaced again by today's scan.
All current ledger tracks, durable rejected entries, frozen Session 4 material and untriggered PARKED revisit entries were excluded.
Yuuta's Kinkaku EP was excluded because its official description foregrounds fast hardgroove, warped vocals, dramatic stabs and dancefloor energy rather than restraint.
COZi's available Touch Deeper track was excluded because the release is explicitly progressive-house leaning and its track-specific function is not documented.
aM.IT's Nonexistent and GEØMMETRISCH's Mensaje Codificado tracks were excluded from ranking because only genre or release-level metadata was available without a concrete track-level hypothesis.
Robag Wruhme's FUMAXOHN was excluded because it is a future preorder on the scan date and most tracks were not yet available for exact identity resolution.

Fin Cormack's Graviton and impact-led, industrial, peak-time, acid-rave and aggressive material were excluded because the available descriptions foreground relentless motion, raw energy or spectacle risk.
No proposed placement enters Iruka → Percussion Work → Interlynx, splits Deep Under → Wurk, or touches Interlynx → Minimum → Eclipse → Haidou → Calipso.
